text: Pinterest priced its IPO on April 17, 2019 at $19 a share and closed its first day at $24.40. The stock fell to a low of $10.92 on March 18, 2020 in the pandemic crash, peaked at $89.15 on February 16, 2021, and closed the five years at $32.73 on April 22, 2024, 72.3% above the offer price. Its filings show advertising revenue surging, then user growth fading as lockdowns eased, before margins improved.
